name: Hyundai Elevator Co., Ltd
summary: Hyundai Elevator Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, installs, maintains, and modernizes elevators, escalators, and moving walkways in South Korea and internationally. The company offers high speed elevators under THE EL name; high-speed elevators under the i-XEL name; and low and mid-speed elevators under the LUXEN, YZER, and N:EX names, as well as observation, freight, automobile, and marine elevators. It also provides special purpose elevators, parking systems, and advanced remote maintenance systems. in addition, the company offers Hyundai Elevator MIRI API platform service, such as remote elevator call and robot interworking services.
